The '''Tenloss Coalition''' was the central organization around which the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] was built. Headquartered on [[Verisin]] in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]], the Tenloss Coalition specialized in kidnapping and occasionaly expanding to [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] operations.<ref name="planets">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The profits allowed the organization to move on to other criminal activities and evolve as the Tenloss Syndicate. The Syndicate maintained the slaving legacy in a smaller scale, and used the [[Vergesso Base]] as a secret transfer point for slaves.<ref name="planets" />
